entries.b522cd64f9f0ed24: Its strength lies in a structure that always keeps about 5,700 product items by size in stock at its factories as standard-stock items and, as ordered, cuts or mills them and delivers them with short lead times. In the “Hakudo Net Service,” the number of items handled has been expanded to 270,200 as of the end of March 2026, and functions such as “Quote and order by DATA” and “Quote and order by drawing” also enable instant quotes and orders for processed products. entries.c98d0d57e6b52ba6: The company and five consolidated subsidiaries (AQR Co., Ltd., Shanghai Hakudo Precision Materials Co., Ltd., Hakudo(Thailand)Co., Ltd., Hakudo USA Inc., and West Coast Aluminum & Stainless, LLC) form the group, and the consolidated number of employees is 401 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.cdedf39af2e62dab: Its management philosophy is: “We will contribute to society by being trusted by all related people and by providing products, convenience and peace of mind to those involved in manufacturing.” Its brand slogan is “Something new, from materials.” The medium-term management plan announced in May 2025, titled “Zenshin: ‘Exceeding Expectations’ STEP,” aims to deepen core businesses and expand business areas on the basis of higher customer satisfaction, through evolution of the Hakudo Net Service, increased added value through expanded processing functions and items, strengthened manufacturing capacity and improved efficiency through factory and SCM reforms, expansion in the semiconductor, automotive and aerospace fields, and expansion of overseas business; it also sets out strengthening of the management foundation and promotion of sustainability management. The plan’s target figures are forward-looking and are not transcribed here.

entries.ee266927eb2bed0a: Its main sales fields are the semiconductor equipment, liquid crystal equipment and machine tool industries, among others, and it also sells to customers in the aerospace and automotive industries. The number of items handled by the “Hakudo Net Service,” which allows quotes and orders over the internet, has been expanded to 270,200 items as of the end of March 2026.
entries.f05f590a323f6c9c: The breakdown by region of revenue of ¥68,109 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, based on revenue from external customers, is: Japan ¥59,371 million, North America ¥5,087 million, China ¥1,926 million, and other regions (Thailand) ¥1,723 million. By product category, sales were ¥41,833 million for aluminum, ¥12,535 million for stainless steel, ¥10,261 million for wrought copper products and ¥3,479 million for others. No major customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue, and information by product and service is omitted because a single category accounts for more than 90%. Results are affected by trends in capital investment in industries such as semiconductor equipment, which are its main sales fields, and by trends in non-ferrous metal market conditions.
